newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Midwest direct hogs seen off $0.50 - private.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Midwest direct hogs seen off $0.50 - private.

text.p: U.S. Midwest direct cash hog prices Thursday were seen $0.50 per cwt lower in scattered trading ahead of the Independence Day holiday on Friday, livestock dealers and packer buyers said.
Sales were expected thin, with many livestock dealers and packer buyers saying they had enough hogs booked for Thursday and would be out of the market.
"We'll be trying to book hogs for Monday, but I don't know for how much," one central Illinois buyer said.
Major U.S. hog slaughter plants will be closed for the holiday on Friday, with only a handful seen open Saturday.

Larger-than-expected interior Iowa and southern Minnesota hog marketings Tuesday and active movement again Wednesday pushed top interior hog prices at plants down $1.50 to a top price of $61.00 after they climbed to $62.50 on Tuesday.
Interior Iowa/southern Minnesota top prices for hogs delivered to plants Thursday were seen down another $0.50 at $60.50, sources there said.
Illinois top prices for hogs at the plant were seen down $0.50 at $59.50 and Indiana/Ohio hog prices could also be down $0.50, with a top at the plant of $60.50, sources in those areas said.
